candidates.snippet: ### Proposal to improve performance  On an RTX 4090 (sm_89), `cutlass_scaled_mm` for int8 W8A8 takes 1.31x to 1.99x longer at M=17 than at M=16 on five of six Qwen3-1.7B linear-layer shapes, and then barely moves until the next power of two. That pattern follows the per-bucket GEMM configurations in `csrc/libtorch_stable/quantization/w8a8/cutlass/scaled_mm_c2x_sm89_int8_dispatch.cuh`, which pick a configuration by `next_pow_2(M)` floored at 16 (the file is unchanged on main).
